title: One Thousand and One Nights (the frame story)
author: anonymous (Arabic tradition)

beats.event: King Shahryar, betrayed, vows to marry then execute a virgin each dawn
The vizier has exhausted the kingdom's supply of brides
Scheherazade volunteers herself over her father's protest
She is married to Shahryar; execution set for dawn
She arranges with her sister Dunyazad to prompt a tale
Wedding night: she begins a story but leaves it unfinished
Curious, the king postpones her execution to hear the ending
Each night she ends a tale on a hook and begins another
The pattern holds through hundreds of nights of storytelling
Over the nights she bears the king children
After a thousand and one nights the tales run out
She asks for pardon; the king sees their children
Shahryar spares her, makes her queen, and ends the terror
